summary: Verified Google Translate DOM crash fix on CaseFilesModal. Logged in as test@advocate.app, opened Case Files via nav-cases, and confirmed rendered HTML attributes are correct. No React reconciliation errors (insertBefore/removeChild) observed on modal open/close path. Created a new case ('Test Case') successfully via + New Case → Save.

console_warnings_noted: Invalid DOM property `fetchpriority` (should be fetchPriority) — unrelated to this fix

notes: Modal did not close on first Escape press after creating a case (Escape may have been consumed by an inner input/dialog). Not a regression of this fix — outer/inner translate attributes remained correct and no DOM reconciliation errors occurred. Clicking the X close button works normally.

Onboarding order in preview: language OK → cookie Essential only → T&C Accept & Continue → welcome-tour-skip → (taster 'Try Lex' modal may auto-open on auth screen; close via [data-testid='taster-close'] before submitting login).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: React warning 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — some element uses lowercase attribute. Non-blocking but should be corrected.
The 'Try Lex' taster modal auto-opens over the auth screen and can obscure the login submit button for automated flows. Consider not auto-opening when the login form is being interacted with.
seed_data_creation: Created a case named 'Test Case' via UI as part of regression check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CaseFilesModal (App.js ~line 6357) has translate='no' lang={lang} on outer [data-testid='cases-modal'] and inner .modal-card also has translate='no' + notranslate class — verified in rendered DOM. Modal opens via [data-testid='nav-cases'] (bottom nav). To reach the app: dismiss language OK → cookie 'Essential only' → tick T&C checkboxes → 'Accept & Continue' → 'welcome-tour-skip' → 'taster-close' (if Try Lex opens) → then fill email/password/submit. Login POST returns 200 quickly.
rca_of_the_issue: Sentry crashes 'Failed to execute insertBefore/removeChild on Node' inside CaseFilesModal were caused by Google Translate (and similar extensions) mutating text nodes React expected to control. Fix added translate='no' + lang={lang} on outer wrapper and translate='no' + notranslate class on inner modal-card so translation extensions skip these subtrees. Verified attributes present in rendered HTML and modal open/create/close path produces zero DOM reconciliation errors.
